data_fields.name: mote density (per effect type)
data_fields.donor_constant: default range 2 to 3; poof 0.001; flame 0.00065 to 0.00085

data_fields.name: mote drag coefficient (per effect type)
data_fields.donor_constant: default range 0.5 to 0.6; poof 0.7 to 0.8; flame 0.2 to 0.3

data_fields.name: spark spin range
data_fields.donor_constant: default range 20 to 60 degrees per second

best_idea: Describe each hit-spark or dust effect as a small data record (count, speed and life ranges, drag, density, collides) and run all of them in one pool with a hard cap that drops a new burst when full and removes dead entries by swapping in the last one.
decision_why: Take the effect-record shape, the hard capacity with drop, and the swap-remove pool; reject the donor's server packet that says spawn this emitter, because Frankendom derives sparks from the server-verified hit event on the client.
acceptance: On each landed hit a player sees a short burst of sparks at the contact point that fades within the effect's life; a client test asserts the pool never exceeds its cap in a three-attacker fight and every mote is removed once its life is spent.
